The '''''Xiytiar''-class heavy transport''' was a cargo ship manufactured by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]].

==Characteristics==
It was shaped like a thin, cylinder highlighted by a bulbous front cargo section and a small, rear engine pod. Although marginally faster than the comparable [[MB-C1 medium transport]], it was less durable in combat.

[[File:Xiytiar_under_attack_SOF.png|thumb|left|A ''Xiytiar''-class transport under attack from [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighters]]]]
Ships of this class measured 164.8 meters in length, could carry 5,000 metric tons of cargo and up to 12 passengers.<ref name="PP" /> The cargo space was versatile, and at least one ''Xiytiar''-class transport, the ''[[Sungrass]]'', was used as a pocket carrier during a covert [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation. Despite this versatility, and their ability to be manned by as few as two people, they were considered amongst the least elegant of all starships by many pilots.

[[Lo Khan]]'s freighter, the ''[[Hyperspace Marauder]]'', was probably the most famous ship of this class. Upgraded with a multi-band computer interface, the ship's co-pilot, [[Luwingo]], made up for the ship's lack of combat ability by [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] into the control systems of attacking craft.

==History==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], several members of [[Wraith Squadron]], under the guise of the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]], operated out of the ''Xiytiar''-class transport ''[[Sungrass]]''.

In [[137 ABY]], a ''Xiytiar''-class transport formed part of a [[Hidden Temple]].<ref name="SWL25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>
